test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: His grip tightend a fractoin on her arm.
His grip tightened a fraction on her arm.
His grrip tightned a fraction on her arm.
His gripe tightened a fracton on her arm.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given sentences, the **one without spelling errors **is *"His grip tightened a fraction on her arm". *

Therefore, the** correct answer** is- **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Option 1 has misspelled "tightened" as** "tightend."**
 
• Option 3 has misspelled "grip" as **"grrip"** and "tightened" as **"tightned."**
 
• Option 4 has misspelled "grip" as **"gripe" **and "fraction" as** "fracton."**
